name: MultiLingual LibriSpeech
description: A large multilingual corpus suitable for speech research. The dataset is derived from read audiobooks from LibriVox and consists of 8 languages - English, German, Dutch, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Polish. It includes about 44.5K hours of English and a total of about 6K hours for other languages.
creator: Vineel Pratap, Qiantong Xu, Anuroop Sriram, Gabriel Synnaeve, Ronan Collobert
inLanguage: de, nl, fr, it, es, pt, pl, en
citeAs: @article{Pratap2020MLSAL,   title={MLS: A Large-Scale Multilingual Dataset for Speech Research},   author={Vineel Pratap and Qiantong Xu and Anuroop Sriram and Gabriel Synnaeve and Ronan Collobert},   journal={ArXiv},   year={2020},   volume={abs/2012.03411} }
rai:dataCollection: The dataset is derived from read audiobooks from LibriVox.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The data archives were restructured from the original ones from OpenSLR to make it easier to stream.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset consists of people who have donated their voice online. Gender information is included in the dataset statistics.
rai:dataLimitations: You agree to not attempt to determine the identity of speakers in this dataset.
rai:dataUseCases: The dataset can be used to train a model for Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), speaker identification, and Text-To-Speech (TTS). For ASR, the model is presented with an audio file and asked to transcribe the audio file to written text. The most common evaluation metric is the word error rate (WER). The dataset is suitable for training, development (dev split), and testing (test split).
